purpose: Verify that an authenticated user enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to a course is granted access to the course workspace.
preconditions: Course C101 exists in the system; User U1 is enrolled in C101 as a student (or assigned as Faculty/TA/Observer); User U1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: User U1 requests access to the course workspace for C101.
expected_result: Access is granted (HTTP 200); course workspace home page displays syllabus, schedule, instructors, and TAs.

purpose: Verify that an authenticated user not enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to a course is denied access to its course workspace.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; User U2 is authenticated but has no enrollment, assignment, or linkage to C101.
action_or_input: User U2 requests access to the course workspace for C101.
expected_result: Access is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden); course workspace content is not displayed.

purpose: Verify that student course access is granted based on active Fusion course-registration records.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Student S1 has an active registration record for C101 in Fusion registration data; Student S1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S1 requests access to course workspace C101.
expected_result: Access is granted based on Fusion registration data; Student S1 successfully enters the C101 course workspace.

purpose: Verify that a student without an active Fusion course-registration record is denied access to the course workspace.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Student S2 is an active student in Fusion but has no registration record for C101; Student S2 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S2 requests access to course workspace C101.
expected_result: Access is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden) based on the absence of Fusion course-registration data.

purpose: Verify that an Observer linked to a course can read course details, published materials, and announcements.
preconditions: Course C101 exists with published materials and announcements; Observer O1 is linked to C101; Observer O1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Observer O1 requests course details, published materials list, and announcements list for C101.
expected_result: Read access is granted (HTTP 200); course details, published materials, and announcements are returned in read-only form.

purpose: Verify that an Observer linked to a course is prohibited from viewing individual student submissions, grades, or student-specific data.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Student S1 has submitted work and received a grade; Observer O1 is linked to C101; Observer O1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to view Student S1's submission, grade, or submission history for C101.
expected_result: Access is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden); no student-specific submission or grade data is disclosed.

purpose: Verify that an Observer has no write access anywhere in the course module.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Observer O1 is linked to C101; Observer O1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts write operations: creating an announcement, uploading material, submitting an assignment, and entering a grade.
expected_result: All write operations are rejected (HTTP 403 Forbidden); no course records are created or modified.

purpose: Verify that an assigned TA can view permitted course content, view student submissions, and grade submissions.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; TA T1 is assigned to C101; Student S1 has submitted work for an assignment; TA T1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: TA T1 requests course content, views Student S1's submission, and inputs points and feedback.
expected_result: Actions are permitted (HTTP 200); submission details are displayed, and TA grading input is accepted and stored.

purpose: Verify that an assigned TA is prohibited from creating or editing assignments, materials, or course structure.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; TA T1 is assigned to C101; TA T1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to create a new assignment, edit an assignment, upload course material, and alter course structure.
expected_result: All authoring and editing actions are rejected (HTTP 403 Forbidden); assignments, materials, and course structure remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that published/released course materials are accessible to Students, TAs, and Observers.
preconditions: Course C101 has course material M1 with status Published; Student S1, TA T1, and Observer O1 are associated with C101.
action_or_input: Student S1, TA T1, and Observer O1 independently request to view/download material M1.
expected_result: Material M1 is visible and successfully returned in read-only form to Student S1, TA T1, and Observer O1 (HTTP 200).

purpose: Verify that unpublished/unreleased course materials are not accessible or visible to Students, TAs, or Observers.
preconditions: Course C101 has course material M2 in unpublished/draft state; Student S1, TA T1, and Observer O1 are associated with C101.
action_or_input: Student S1, TA T1, and Observer O1 attempt to list materials or directly access M2.
expected_result: Material M2 is excluded from materials listing and direct access requests are denied (HTTP 403 or HTTP 404).

purpose: Verify that course material configured with a future release date remains unavailable before that date/time.
preconditions: Course C101 has material M3 configured with a future release timestamp T_release; current system time is T_current < T_release; Student S1 is enrolled in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 requests the course materials list and attempts direct access to M3 at T_current.
expected_result: Material M3 maintains Scheduled status, does not appear in published materials, and direct access is denied.

purpose: Verify that course material configured with a future release date automatically becomes available once release date/time is reached.
preconditions: Course C101 has material M3 configured with release timestamp T_release; system clock advances to T_now >= T_release; Student S1 is enrolled in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 requests the course materials list and views M3 at T_now.
expected_result: Material M3 transitions to released state and is visible and downloadable by Student S1 (HTTP 200).

purpose: Verify that Faculty assigned to a course can post course announcements.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101; Faculty F1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 submits a course announcement with title and content.
expected_result: Announcement is created and posted successfully (HTTP 201 Created).

purpose: Verify that a TA can post a course announcement when permitted by Faculty for the course.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; TA T1 is assigned to C101; Faculty has granted announcement-posting permission to T1 for C101; TA T1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: TA T1 submits a course announcement with title and content.
expected_result: Announcement is created and posted successfully (HTTP 201 Created).

purpose: Verify that a TA cannot post a course announcement when not permitted by Faculty for that course.
preconditions: Course C101 exists; TA T2 is assigned to C101; TA T2 does NOT have announcement-posting permission for C101; TA T2 is authenticated.
action_or_input: TA T2 attempts to post a course announcement for C101.
expected_result: Action is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden); no announcement is posted.

purpose: Verify that a posted announcement records a valid timestamp and is visible course-wide to all enrolled/linked users.
preconditions: Course C101 has enrolled Student S1, assigned Faculty F1, assigned TA T1, and linked Observer O1; Faculty F1 posts announcement A1 at timestamp T1.
action_or_input: Student S1, TA T1, and Observer O1 query announcements for course C101.
expected_result: Announcement A1 displays creation timestamp T1 and is visible in the announcements list to S1, T1, and O1.

purpose: Verify that an announcement is not visible to users not enrolled in or linked to the course.
preconditions: Course C101 has posted announcement A1; User U3 has no enrollment, assignment, or linkage to C101; User U3 is authenticated.
action_or_input: User U3 attempts to view announcement A1 or fetch C101 announcements list.
expected_result: Access is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden); announcement content is not returned.

purpose: Verify that an assignment defining due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible passes validation and can be published.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101; assignment draft A_valid defines due date='2026-09-30 23:59', instructions='Complete lab report', submission type='file', and points possible=100.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 triggers the publish action on assignment A_valid.
expected_result: Validation succeeds; assignment status is updated to Published (HTTP 200).

purpose: Verify that an assignment missing any required configuration field (due date, instructions, submission type, points possible) cannot be published.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101; assignment draft A_invalid defines instructions, submission type, and due date, but points possible is missing.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 attempts to publish assignment A_invalid.
expected_result: Publication fails validation (HTTP 400 Bad Request); required field error is reported and assignment remains in Draft state.

purpose: Verify that an assignment remains in Draft state upon creation and before Faculty publishes it.
preconditions: Faculty F1 creates a new assignment for course C101 with all required fields configured but does not trigger publish.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 saves the assignment and queries its lifecycle state.
expected_result: Assignment state is confirmed as 'Draft'; assignment is not published and not exposed to students.

purpose: Verify that an assignment transitions from Draft to Published state upon explicit publish action by Faculty.
preconditions: Assignment A1 in course C101 is in Draft state with complete required configuration; Faculty F1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 executes the publish action on assignment A1.
expected_result: Assignment state successfully transitions from 'Draft' to 'Published'.

purpose: Verify that a published assignment with a future release date is not visible to Students before that date/time.
preconditions: Assignment A1 in C101 is Published with release timestamp T_release in the future; current system time is T_current < T_release; Student S1 is enrolled in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 requests the assignments list for course C101 at T_current.
expected_result: Assignment A1 is omitted from Student S1's assignments list and direct access is denied/hidden (HTTP 404 or 403).

purpose: Verify that a published assignment becomes visible to Students once its configured release date/time condition is satisfied.
preconditions: Assignment A1 in C101 is Published with release timestamp T_release; system clock reaches T_now >= T_release; Student S1 is enrolled in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 requests the assignments list for course C101 at T_now.
expected_result: Assignment A1 appears in Student S1's assignments list, displaying instructions, due date, submission type, and points possible.

purpose: Verify that a student submission matching the assignment's configured submission type (file, text, or link) is accepted.
preconditions: Course C101 has published assignment A1 with submission type configured as 'file'; Student S1 is enrolled in C101; current time is before due date.
action_or_input: Student S1 submits an assignment payload containing a valid file upload.
expected_result: Submission is accepted and validated successfully (HTTP 201 Created); submission status is marked as 'submitted'.

purpose: Verify that a student submission not conforming to the assignment's configured submission type is rejected.
preconditions: Course C101 has published assignment A1 configured strictly for 'file' submission; Student S1 is enrolled in C101; current time is before due date.
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to submit text or a URL link instead of a file.
expected_result: Submission is rejected (HTTP 400 Bad Request); validation error indicates non-conforming submission type.

purpose: Verify that a Student submission made prior to the configured due date is accepted as an on-time submission.
preconditions: Assignment A1 has due date T_due; current time T_sub is strictly before T_due (T_sub < T_due); Student S1 is enrolled and submits conforming payload.
action_or_input: Student S1 submits work for assignment A1 at timestamp T_sub.
expected_result: Submission is accepted and recorded; submission status is marked as 'submitted' and timestamp T_sub is stored.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view their own submission history and status.
preconditions: Student S1 has submitted work for assignment A1 in course C101; Student S1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S1 requests their submission history and status for assignment A1.
expected_result: Request succeeds (HTTP 200); Student S1's own submission details, timestamp, and status ('submitted') are returned.

purpose: Verify that a Student cannot view another student's submission history or status.
preconditions: Student S1 and Student S2 are enrolled in C101; Student S2 has submitted work for assignment A1; Student S1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to view Student S2's submission history or status for assignment A1.
expected_result: Access is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden); Student S2's submission details are not returned.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can grade an individual submission and the grading action is attributed to the Faculty user.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to C101; Student S1 has submitted work for assignment A1; Faculty F1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 submits points (85) and feedback ('Well done') for Student S1's submission.
expected_result: Grade and feedback are saved; audit record attributes Faculty F1 as the grader.

purpose: Verify that a TA can grade an individual submission and the grading action is attributed to the TA user.
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to C101; Student S1 has submitted work for assignment A1; TA T1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: TA T1 submits points (80) and feedback ('Good effort') for Student S1's submission.
expected_result: Grade and feedback are saved; audit record attributes TA T1 as the grader.

purpose: Verify that an unauthorized user (such as a Student or Observer) cannot grade a submission.
preconditions: Student S1 and Observer O1 are associated with C101; Student S2 has submitted work for assignment A1.
action_or_input: Student S1 (and Observer O1) attempts to submit a grade and feedback for Student S2's submission.
expected_result: Grading attempt is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden); submission grade remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that grades and feedback in Draft state are invisible to the Student.
preconditions: Submission of Student S1 has been graded by Faculty/TA; grade and feedback are saved in Draft state (unreleased); Student S1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S1 views the assignment and course grade page.
expected_result: Draft grade and feedback are not visible to Student S1; grade status indicates pending release.

purpose: Verify that once grades are released, the Student can view their grade and feedback.
preconditions: Submission of Student S1 has been graded and the grade has been released; Student S1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S1 views the assignment and course grade page.
expected_result: Released grade (points) and feedback are visible to Student S1 (HTTP 200).

purpose: Verify that Faculty has the authority to release grades and feedback to Students.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to C101; draft grades exist for assignment A1 submissions; Faculty F1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 triggers the grade release action for assignment A1.
expected_result: Grades transition from Draft to Released state; release action succeeds (HTTP 200).

purpose: Verify that a TA cannot release grades and that TA grading does not by itself release grades.
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to C101; draft grades exist for assignment A1; TA T1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to trigger the grade release action for assignment A1.
expected_result: Action is denied (HTTP 403 Forbidden); grades remain in Draft state and are not released to students.

purpose: Verify that after grade release, a Student views their own grade and feedback strictly in read-only form.
preconditions: Grade and feedback for Student S1's submission have been released by Faculty; Student S1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S1 requests their grade and feedback details.
expected_result: Grade and feedback are presented in read-only form; no edit controls or input fields are available to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that a Student cannot perform write or edit operations on their released grade or feedback.
preconditions: Grade and feedback for Student S1's submission have been released; Student S1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student S1 sends an update/PUT/PATCH request attempting to modify points or feedback of their submission.
expected_result: Request is rejected (HTTP 403 Forbidden); grade and feedback remain unaltered.

purpose: Verify that whenever a released grade is changed, an audit record is logged with the actor identity and timestamp.
preconditions: Submission for Student S1 in C101 has a released grade (points: 85); Faculty F1 is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates the released grade to points: 90 with updated feedback at timestamp T_change.
expected_result: Grade is updated to 90 and an audit log entry is created recording Faculty F1's user ID, timestamp T_change, previous grade (85), and new grade (90).
